Output 1 - The Planning, M&E and Statistics Framework established No standards for planning in the government at FGS and FMS level in place; 0 FMS strategic plans aligned to NDP 9 Not yet established, law approved.
Planning prodoc finalized, approved in UNDP QA process. Document has been circulated to donors and fundraising is under way.
Support to the SNBS for SDGs Commitee meetings provided. The first Voluntary review for the FGS carried out. Second local voluntary review for civil society and private sector conducted in Mogadishu. Capacity support for 6 staff members provided to the SNBS.
First ever, Voluntary National Review Report presented to the UN HPLF by Somalia in New York in July 2022.
Output 2 – The Operational platform NDP 2020-2024 is strengthened No Aid Policy yet AIMS not yet operational While Puntland has an operational structure, the other FMS only have irregular coordination meetings.
Output 3: SDG Alignment further developed Guidelines not yet made No consolidated structure for reporting on progress of SDG implementation exists SDG Unit in MOPIC Somaliland recently established
